content: MSAL Python provides in-memory token cache by default and requires custom serialization for persistence. Use SerializableTokenCache serialize and deserialize with has_state_changed. For web apps keep one token cache per account and store in a database or secret store. initiate_auth_code_flow returns a dict including auth_uri and state that must be persisted server side and passed to acquire_token_by_auth_code_flow. The MSAL Django sample shows this pattern.
